mode_contract.ordinary_circuit: sourcePerformance=1 and parity=0; source models and software LFO, FX and arp overlays are active.
mode_contract.pure: parity takes precedence over sourcePerformance. LFO depth/destination, FX type/model/mix and arp enable are effectively masked. Raw parameters remain stored. Factory and user-preset recall preserve the session Pure flag.
mode_contract.studio_visibility: PluginEditor::showAdvanced changes overlay visibility, focus and repaint only. Its open/closed state is not an audio-policy switch.
mode_contract.clocking: The authored LFO and arpeggiator rates are free-running Hz/notes-per-second; no host-tempo synchronization is advertised or used by these routes.
mode_contract.model_zero: Phaser Strings and Phased Polysynth use FX model0 with classic type2. Zero modern model means the classic phaser branch, not bypass.

limits: An active control-flow route does not establish perceptual prominence, acoustic realism or arbitrary-performance quality.
Pure intentionally changes multiple controls, so it is not an isolated modern-effect A/B comparison.
The delay numbers are nominal target laws; tape wow/flutter and feedback decay remain active.
PARITY_ISOLATION.md has historical host-count and decimator-only latency wording. Current Engine and plugin code are authoritative for this audit; no documentation edits were made.
